title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
我叫莫伊拉。我有全世界最好的爸爸妈妈！我们有两只滑稽的小狗，它们叫佐罗和斯普林特。我有点儿调皮、任性，有时候还笨手笨脚的，妈妈说：“没关系！宝贝。”
可我还是挺烦恼的，尤其当我有事不想也不敢说出来的时候，就像昨天……
page_text_en:
My name is Moira. I have the best parents in the world! We have two funny little dogs, named Zorro and Sprint. I’m a bit mischievous and stubborn, and sometimes clumsy too. Mom says, “It’s okay! Sweetie.”
But I still feel troubled, especially when I have something I don’t want to—or dare to—say, like yesterday…
summary_zh: 女孩莫伊拉介绍了自己的家庭和宠物，并表达了自己虽然被父母包容，但仍有不敢说出烦恼的困扰，引出故事的开端。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 早上七点，我起床了。啊，我掀开被子，迅速穿好衣服，一切顺利，直到——我看见裤袜上露出一根线头。我轻轻一扯，竟然扯出了一个小洞。然后，嘶嘶嘶……小洞变得越来越大。不好！这可怎么办？
page_text_en: It's seven o'clock in the morning, and I've woken up. Ah, I pull back the covers, quickly get dressed, everything goes smoothly, until— I see a loose thread on my tights. I give it a gentle tug, and suddenly, a small hole appears. Then, *riiiip*... the hole gets bigger and bigger. Oh no! What should I do?
summary_zh: 女孩莫伊拉早上起床后发现裤袜上有个线头，一拉就扯出了一个洞，而且洞越来越大，她感到非常焦急和不知所措。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
“嘿，”妈妈说，“你换了条裤袜，也很好看嘛！”我想告诉她发生了什么，那些话已经冲到了嗓子眼儿，可是，哧溜！它们又被我吞回了肚子里。我想，这下它们安全了。
我飞快地换上另一条裤袜，把破了的那条藏起来。
不告诉别人，一个小秘密没什么大不了。
page_text_en:
"Hey," Mom said, "you changed into a pair of tights, and they look great!" I wanted to tell her what happened. Those words had already rushed to my throat, but then—slish!—they were swallowed back down into my stomach. I thought, now they’re safe.
I quickly put on another pair of tights and hid the torn one.
Not telling anyone, a little secret isn’t such a big deal.
summary_zh: 女孩莫伊拉在妈妈夸她新裤袜好看时，想解释裤袜破洞的事，但最终把话咽了回去，选择换上另一条并藏起破的那条，认为一个小秘密没什么大不了。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
在学校，我一直在想这事儿。
要是妈妈知道我弄破了裤袜，肯定会不高兴。
她以前总说：“不要拉线头，要爱惜你的衣服！”
吃水果的时间到了，我的肚子开始发痒。它不喜欢梨，我也不喜欢，于是我把梨放回了包里。
page_text_en:
At school, I kept thinking about this.
If Mom found out I tore my tights, she’d be unhappy.
She always said, “Don’t pull threads, take care of your clothes!”
It was time for fruit. My tummy started to itch. It doesn’t like pears, and I don’t either, so I put the pear back in my bag.
summary_zh: 女孩在学校里继续为弄破裤袜的事感到焦虑，担心妈妈会不高兴，同时因为不喜欢梨而将水果放回包里，表现出她内心的不安和回避行为。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
放学后，本杰明要到我家玩，我们一块儿往家走。快到家的时候，我想起了那个梨，也想起了爸爸的话：“一定要把水果吃掉，莫伊拉！维生素是我们的好朋友！”
要是爸爸看到梨还在我包里，他肯定会生气的。知道我是怎么干的吗？我迅速把梨掏出来，扔进了垃圾桶里。
page_text_en:
After school, Benjamin was coming to play at my house, and we walked home together. As we got close to home, I thought about that pear and also remembered what Dad said: 'You must eat your fruit, Moira! Vitamins are our good friends!'
If Dad saw the pear still in my bag, he'd definitely get angry. Do you know what I did? I quickly pulled the pear out and threw it into the trash can.
summary_zh: 放学后，莫伊拉和本杰明一起回家，她想起自己没吃掉的梨，担心爸爸会生气，于是偷偷把梨扔进了垃圾桶。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 我们一进家门，爸爸就问道：“宝贝，今天过得怎么样？”我差点儿就要张开嘴，把裤袜和梨的事告诉他。这时，我听到本杰明在喊：“莫伊拉，快来，我有一个绝妙的主意！”于是我把那些小秘密，又咽回了肚子里，那里的空间足够大。我以后再告诉爸爸。
page_text_en: As soon as we walked in the door, Dad asked, “Honey, how was your day?” I almost opened my mouth to tell him about the tights and the pear. Then I heard Benjamin shouting, “Moira, come here, I’ve got a brilliant idea!” So I swallowed those little secrets back down into my stomach, where there was plenty of room. I’ll tell Dad later.
summary_zh: 女孩莫伊拉回家后本想向爸爸坦白裤袜破洞和没吃梨的事，但听到弟弟本杰明喊她时，她又把秘密咽了回去，决定以后再告诉爸爸。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
“我们结婚，好吗？”本杰明热切地问我，“我穿你爸爸的西装，你可以穿你妈妈的婚纱。”太好玩了，我立刻大喊：“好哇！我愿意！我愿意！”
这件婚纱显然太——大，也太——长啦！可我看上去多美呀。本杰明也穿上了超大的西装，他看起来有点儿像企鹅。在婚礼上，我突然很想尿尿。
page_text_en:
"Let's get married, okay?" Benjamin asked me eagerly, "I'll wear Dad's suit, and you can wear Mom's wedding dress." It was so much fun, I shouted immediately, "Yes! I do! I do!"
This wedding dress was obviously too—big, and too—long! But I looked so beautiful. Benjamin also put on an oversized suit; he looked a bit like a penguin. At the wedding, I suddenly really wanted to pee.
summary_zh: 莫伊拉和弟弟本杰明玩结婚游戏，她穿上妈妈的婚纱，本杰明穿上爸爸的西装，两人在想象的婚礼中玩耍，莫伊拉在兴奋之余突然感到想上厕所。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 我跌跌撞撞地跑进洗手间，坐在了马桶上。哗啦！哗啦！哗啦！尿了好多，真舒服。不好！我光想着尿尿的事，居然没注意到——我全尿在了婚纱上！真是太可怕了！我慌慌张张地脱掉婚纱，把它挂回了衣柜里。我告诉本杰明他该回家了，婚礼结束了。
page_text_en: I stumbled into the bathroom and sat on the toilet. Splash! Splash! Splash! I peed a lot, and it felt so good. Oh no! I was so focused on peeing that I didn’t notice—I peed all over the wedding dress! That was terrible! I frantically took off the dress and hung it back in the closet. I told Benjamin it was time for him to go home; the wedding was over.
summary_zh: 莫伊拉在和弟弟玩结婚游戏时突然想上厕所，慌忙跑进洗手间，结果尿在了婚纱上，她感到害怕，慌张地脱下婚纱并告诉弟弟婚礼结束。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
晚餐简直是一场灾难！我只能喝下汤，根本吃不下肉。我嚼呀！嚼呀！嘎吱……嘎吱……好多话堵在了嗓子眼儿，好多秘密塞满了肚子。
我偷偷地把肉给了佐罗和斯普林特，连甜点也没吃，就径直跑回了房间。
page_text_en:
Dinner was a disaster! I could only drink the soup and couldn't eat the meat at all. Chew, chew! Crunch... crunch... so many words were stuck in my throat, and so many secrets filled my stomach.
I secretly gave the meat to Zorro and Sprint, didn't even eat dessert, and ran straight back to my room.
summary_zh: 莫伊拉在晚餐时感到焦虑，无法进食，将肉偷偷喂给宠物后，带着满腹秘密跑回房间。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
我坐在床上，伤心极了。我非常难受，我的肚子痛，我不知道该怎么办。
啪嗒！啪嗒！啪嗒！
嗒噔！嗒噔！嗒噔！
爸爸妈妈上楼来了。“亲爱的，告诉我们，发生什么事儿了？”妈妈非常温柔、体贴地，把手放在了我的肚子上。
我再也控制不住我的那些小秘密了，它们一下子全跑了出来。
我把裤袜扯出了一个洞，还把梨扔进了垃圾桶，我不小心把婚纱尿脏了，还把肉偷偷扔给了佐罗和斯普林特……
page_text_en:
I sat on the bed, heartbroken. I felt terrible, my stomach hurt, and I didn't know what to do.
Tap! Tap! Tap!
Ding! Ding! Ding!
Dad and Mom came upstairs. "Dear, tell us, what happened?" Mom was very gentle and caring, placing her hand on my stomach.
I could no longer hold back my little secrets; they all burst out at once.
I tore a hole in my tights, threw the pear in the trash can, accidentally peed on the wedding dress, and secretly gave the meat to Zorro and Sprocket...
summary_zh: 莫伊拉因内心积压的多个秘密而感到极度伤心和身体不适，当父母上楼关心她时，她终于无法再隐瞒，将自己弄破裤袜、扔掉梨、尿湿婚纱以及偷偷喂肉给宠物的全部秘密一并坦白出来。

title_en: I'm Afraid to Say I'm Scared of Being Scolded
source_file: 我不敢说我怕被骂（3-6 岁） .pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
“嗯，乖女儿，说出来一定舒服多了吧。”妈妈说。爸爸把我搂在怀里，对我说：“亲爱的，你要知道，不管发生了什么事儿，你都可以告诉我们，有时候，我们会有点儿生气或难过，但我们永远都是最最爱你的。”
“还有，你知道吗？”妈妈说，“你装着一肚子的秘密过完这一天，才是最让我们难过的事。”说完，她冲我眨了眨眼睛，爸爸给了我一个大大的吻。当眼泪擦干后，所有的秘密也都消失不见了。
“现在，肚子里装得下美味的甜点了吧？”妈妈问。你猜怎么着？我从来没吃过那么美味的甜点！
page_text_en:
"Well, sweetie, it must feel much better to say it out loud," Mom said. Dad hugged me close and said, "Dear, you should know that no matter what happens, you can always tell us. Sometimes we might get a little angry or sad, but we will always, always love you the most."
"And you know what?" Mom said, "Carrying all those secrets inside you for a whole day is what hurts us the most." After saying that, she winked at me, and Dad gave me a big kiss. When the tears were wiped away, all the secrets had disappeared too.
"Now, do you think your tummy can fit some delicious dessert?" Mom asked. Guess what? I've never tasted such a delicious dessert before!
summary_zh: 莫伊拉向父母坦白了所有秘密后，父母给予她温暖的拥抱和安慰，告诉她无论发生什么他们永远爱她，她心中的负担也随之消失，感到轻松并期待吃甜点。
